about: The Rig's reproducible randomness. seed = 32 bytes (hex), shown as SHA-256(seed) at setup and in full at the reveal. draw(label, n): for c = 0, 1, 2, ...: h = HMAC-SHA256(key = seed, message = UTF-8 of label + ':' + c in decimal); u = the first byte of h (0-255); if u < 256 - (256 mod n) return u mod n, else try the next c (n is at most 16 here; rejection_case shows a draw that needed it). Honest reel k (1-3) of spin s = symbol[draw('reel:s:k', 6)] in ring order hat, saucer, dish, eye, moon, lizard. The j-th re-roll of spin s (j from 0, in the order the cards use them) = draw('reroll:s:j', 5), an index into the five symbols other than the one being replaced, kept in ring order (see reroll_symbols). Shuffle(label, list): for i from len-1 down to 1: j = draw(label + ':' + i, i + 1), swap list[i] and list[j]. Deal attempt a: shuffle('deck:a', the preset's deck in card-number order); the first d cards are the dead cards (Full 3, Lite 4); Mechanic m (0-based, rotation order) gets cards d+2m and d+2m+1; if any choice of kept cards would break the machine rules, try a+1 (at most 64; then the round can't start: code rules). Slot order = shuffle('slot', [Mechanic indexes]).
